about_the_game:
THE DRONE LORD is a fast-paced Virtual Reality First Person Shooter that will keep you on the edge of your seat dodging energy beams, bullets and canon fire.

Blast your way through many types of enemy drones on increasingly difficult levels.

Depending on which level you will have a range of weapons: Machine guns, Rocket launchers, Flame Lasers, Shotguns, Poison Sprays (for organic drones), Crossbows (for ancient times) and more.

And all this set to a "kick ass" soundtrack.

You are shielded by an armored levitation suit that can take 1 or 2 enemy strikes, but 3 strikes and you're out. That means back to the start of the level.

Not all weapons will defeat all drones. You'll need to experiment with different combinations.

Success on a level lets you enter the time / space portal to transport you to the next level. Be prepared for a number of surprises the Drone Lord has cooked up for you along the way.

Good Luck Hotshot.

And remember: "FORTUNE FAVORS THE BOLD".

name: The Drone Lord

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 or 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Good
  • VR Support: Quest 2. Meta Quest Headsets. Oculus should be set as the PC's default OpenXR Runtime
  • Additional Notes: The Drone Lord is a Unity PC VR game built on a Windows machine into a Windows.exe The game was built entirely using: VR headset: A Quest 2 headset. PC Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10870H CPU @ 2.20GHz, 2208 Mhz, 8 Core(s), 16 Logical Processor(s) Unless you've got super fast Air Link your headset needs to be connected to your PC via a link cable.

short_description: THE DRONE LORD is a Virtual Reality First Person Shooter. Dodge the enemy drones in your armored levitation suit. Blast them with multiple weapon systems.
